mapper.sql: s.id, s.museum_id, m.name AS museum_name, s.exhibition_id, e.name AS exhibition_name, s.visit_date, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.total_capacity, s.booked_count, (s.total_capacity - s.booked_count) AS remaining, s.status, s.created_at
FROM visit_slot s LEFT JOIN museum m ON m.id = s.museum_id LEFT JOIN exhibition e ON e.id = s.exhibition_id
